comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Tiny rural Alaska utility with large telephone and broadband operations; different mix and hydro/diesel generation, not a mainstream regulated electric holding company.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Rate-regulated vertically integrated electric utility with generation, transmission and distribution; gas segment is an addition, but electricity is core.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Mainly natural gas distribution, pipelines and propane; electric is minor, so the business differs from an electric utility.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Regulated electric T&D utility holding company, wires-focused like TNMP, with gas and steam extras; electricity is the largest part.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility; similar regulation but a different product and customer base.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Unregulated merchant coal generator selling wholesale power; no regulated rate base or distribution network.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Gas distribution utility plus wholesale energy marketing and storage; product is natural gas, not electricity.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Pure natural gas distribution utility; same regulated model but different commodity and no electric generation or transmission.
